ingredients.description: Mellow brassica root, sweeter than turnip, with earthy-mustardy notes. A staple of mashes and stews.
ingredients.surprising: Swede & nutmeg — warm spice lifts the earthiness

ingredients.name: Watercress
ingredients.description: Peppery, mustard-hot leaves with fresh green notes. A bright, bitter counterpoint to rich foods.
ingredients.classic: Watercress & beef — peppery foil to roast beef
ingredients.surprising: Watercress & orange — bitter-sweet salad classic

ingredients.name: Dill
ingredients.description: Feathery herb with fresh, grassy, faintly aniseed and citrus notes. Essential to Nordic and Eastern European cooking.
ingredients.surprising: Dill & beetroot — shared fresh, earthy-green notes

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.description: Clean, grassy and peppery. Flat-leaf is the workhorse herb; the green backbone of gremolata, chimichurri and salsa verde.
ingredients.surprising: Parsley & banana — shared fresh green notes

ingredients.name: Sage
ingredients.description: Camphoraceous, savoury and slightly bitter. Loves fat — fried in butter it turns nutty and crisp.
ingredients.surprising: Sage & apple — savoury-sweet stuffing pairing

ingredients.name: Anise & Fennel Seed
ingredients.description: Sweet, liquorice-like anethole. Spans star anise, aniseed and fennel seed — warming and aromatic in both sweet and savoury dishes.
ingredients.classic: Anise & fish — Provençal and Chinese braises
ingredients.surprising: Star anise & beef — Vietnamese pho aromatic

ingredients.name: Nutmeg
ingredients.description: Warm, woody and sweet with a faint camphor edge. A pinch lifts dairy, spinach and custards.
ingredients.surprising: Nutmeg & cauliflower — warm spice over a gratin

ingredients.name: Clove
ingredients.description: Intensely warm, sweet and medicinal (eugenol). A little goes a long way in hams, mulled drinks and spice blends.
ingredients.classic: Clove & orange — pomander and mulled wine
ingredients.surprising: Clove & beef — studded into braises and stocks

ingredients.name: Saffron
ingredients.description: Honeyed, hay-like and floral with a luxurious golden colour. Defines paella, bouillabaisse and Persian rice.
ingredients.surprising: Saffron & vanilla — floral-sweet dessert pairing

ingredients.name: Juniper
ingredients.description: Piney, resinous berries with a citrus lift — the soul of gin. Cuts through rich game and cured meats.
ingredients.classic: Juniper & game — venison and wild boar
ingredients.surprising: Juniper & grapefruit — shared pine-citrus terpenes

ingredients.name: Horseradish
ingredients.description: Pungent, sinus-clearing heat from the same mustard-oil compounds as wasabi. A sharp foil to fatty proteins.
ingredients.classic: Horseradish & roast beef — the British pairing
ingredients.surprising: Horseradish & smoked fish — heat cuts the oil

ingredients.name: Walnut
ingredients.description: Rich, tannic and slightly bitter. Toasting deepens its earthy, buttery character.
ingredients.classic: Walnut & blue cheese — salad and board classic
ingredients.surprising: Walnut & coffee — shared roasted, bitter depth

ingredients.name: Chestnut
ingredients.description: Sweet, starchy and mild with a soft, floury texture. Bridges sweet and savoury — stuffings, soups and confections.
ingredients.surprising: Chestnut & chocolate — Mont Blanc dessert

ingredients.name: Peanut
ingredients.description: Roasted, savoury-sweet legume with deep nutty notes that overlap with chocolate and coffee.
ingredients.surprising: Peanut & chicken — satay and Thai sauces

ingredients.name: Caper
ingredients.description: Pickled flower buds — briny, tangy and floral. A piquant lift for fish, sauces and pasta.
ingredients.classic: Caper & lemon — with fish and piccata
ingredients.surprising: Caper & raisin — sweet-sour Sicilian agrodolce

ingredients.name: Anchovy
ingredients.description: Intensely savoury cured fish — a pure umami bomb that melts into sauces and dressings, boosting depth without tasting fishy.
ingredients.classic: Anchovy & garlic — bagna càuda, Caesar dressing
ingredients.surprising: Anchovy & beef — melted into a rich gravy for umami

ingredients.name: Caviar
ingredients.description: Briny, buttery cured roe with a delicate marine pop. A luxury garnish that loves fat and acidity.
ingredients.surprising: Caviar & white chocolate — shared creamy amines
